name: Winter squash
latin: Cucurbita maxima, C. moschata, C. pepo

notes.sowing: Sow outdoors {cm:2.5} deep, two or three seeds per spot, 1 to 3 weeks after your last frost once the soil is at least {c:18}. Or sow indoors, one seed per pot at least {cm:5} wide, about 4 weeks before planting out.
notes.care: Trailing types need about {cm:150} between plants; small-fruited types such as acorn can be trellised. Water about {cm:2.5} a week at the base. Set ripening fruit on a board or tile to keep it off damp soil.
notes.harvest: Harvest when the rind is hard and the stem is drying, always before a hard freeze. Cut with {cm:10} of stem, cure in sun or at about {c:27} for 1 to 2 weeks, then store at {c:10} to {c:15}.
